build.note: Product code as merged on main. Two P0 fixes are open, unmerged PRs and are marked FAIL against this build: #54 filmstrip (PR #60) and #55 lost media reference (PR #61).

devices.detail: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest, Android API 35 google_apis x86_64, emulator-5554
Windows 11 host, no emulator (Play-store image needs 7.4 GB, ~6.1 GB free; every GPU/partition variant fails to boot) and no authorized physical device

status_legend.PASS: executed on this build by an automated suite or a named check; the evidence field names it
status_legend.FAIL: proven defect on this build; the linked issue carries the evidence
status_legend.VERIFY: implementation exists in source and is reachable from the UI, but was not executed on a device in this pass
status_legend.BLOCKED: cannot be executed with the hardware/accounts available here; the blocker field says what is missing

cases.case: Bundled sound-library audio is audible in the exported MP4
cases.evidence: EdlToComposition.audibleClips drops every clip whose assetId is null, and the comment there states bundled library sounds ('generated clips, whose sourceUrl has no asset-table entry') are skipped. Library audio elements carry sourceUrl and no mediaId (packages/editor-core/src/sounds/local-sounds.ts), so they play in preview and vanish from the export. Filed as #63 with both code sites.

cases.case: Video-only source exports as a video-only MP4 without an impossible audio item
cases.evidence: instrumented exports_a_video_only_mp4_without_creating_an_impossible_audio_item

cases.case: Audio that outlasts the visual timeline is clamped, never truncated silently
cases.evidence: instrumented export_clamps_audio_that_outlasts_visual_timeline

cases.case: A project stays exportable after media elements are inserted, and a broken reference is reported with the clip named
cases.evidence: Reproduced on main@1027a28: creating a clip through the insert path could store a media element with no assetId, after which native export fails with 'clip ... has no assetId' (EdlToComposition.requireAsset) and the project cannot be exported. Fixed on PR #61 with a native error that names the clip, an insert-time rejection, and an export pre-flight; not merged into this build. Report: issue #55 comment 6610436554.

cases.case: No outbound network calls from source or the built bundle
cases.evidence: bash scripts/invariants.sh offline-audit gate: 'clean — no outbound-network references found in source or the built bundle'

cases.case: No telemetry, ads or payment SDK ships
cases.evidence: same offline gate plus app/build.gradle dependency list: no analytics/ads/billing dependency, no google-services.json required (build.gradle guards its absence).

cases.case: Manifest permissions match the Data Safety / privacy claims
cases.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml declares INTERNET, CAMERA (declared but unreachable in v0.1), no READ_MEDIA_* and no RECORD_AUDIO; allowBackup=false. INTERNET is declared although nothing in source uses the network — harmless at runtime but worth aligning with the Data Safety wording.

cases.case: DEX optimisation / R8 readiness
cases.evidence: app/build.gradle sets minifyEnabled false with the stock proguard-rules.pro, so the shipped DEX is unobfuscated — exactly Play's 1% obfuscation warning. Analysis and the keep-rule worklist are in docs/qa/release-quality-audit.md (#57).

summary.note: PASS means the named suite or gate executed on this build. VERIFY means the code path exists and is reachable but was not executed on a device in this pass. BLOCKED means no device, emulator, keystore or Console access was available. No row is inferred from another row.
